findings.title: Topic activation loses keyboard focus
findings.scenario: Keyboard-activate a topic link in selected details or a preview. filterTopic removes that view, then attempts to focus search.
findings.cause: container is ref={container} on .map-canvas. The .map-directory-panel is a sibling outside that subtree, so container.querySelector('.map-directory-panel input[type=search]') always returns null. Focus remains on a removed element/body rather than the intended search input.
findings.proposedFix: Use the existing panel ref to select the main .map-search input; preserve preventScroll. Coordinate before editing.
findings.testGap: Added execution-level regression for the actual component handler with mocked view/focus targets: details and preview origins, deferred focus, query/kind retention, cleared navigation and preventScroll. This is not a mounted browser DOM or physical-keyboard test.
